mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia can prolong QT interval, and fexofenadine has dose-dependent QT prolongation risk, particularly when electrolytes are depleted.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; consider ECG monitoring if high-dose fexofenadine is required; maintain electrolyte supplementation with bumetanide therapy.
